brief_title: Synbiotic as an Adjuvant Therapy for Dyslipidaemia and Gut Health
official_title: Evaluation of Synbiotic as an Adjuvant Therapy for Dyslipidaemia and Gut Health: A Randomised Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study

arm_groups.label: LAB12 Synbiotic Group
intervention_names: Dietary Supplement: Synbiotic (LAB12 and SWEOAT® Bran)

primary_outcomes.measure: Change from Baseline in Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C)

brief_summary: This 12-week randomized study investigates the effects of a synbiotic supplement (LAB12-G, combining oat-derived β-glucan and L. plantarum LAB12) on individuals with dyslipidemia who are currently on statin therapy. Participants will be assigned to either the LAB12-G treatment group or a placebo group receiving a β-glucan-free oat-based product. Both groups will consume two sachets of their assigned product daily by mixing with 200 mL of water during breakfast and dinner. Participants are required to continue all their medications including the statins throughout the whole study. The primary objectives are to evaluate whether this synbiotic combination improves cholesterol levels and gut microbiota composition when used alongside standard statin treatment.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male and female aged 18-65 years.
* Have intermediate (moderate) CVD risk i.e., 10-20% 10-year CVD risk based on Framingham Risk Score AND have LDL-C level of \>2.6 mmol/L on 10-20 mg of atorvastatin, 5-10 mg of rosuvastatin or 20-40 mg of simvastatin (NICE, 2023).
* BMI of 18.5 - 40.0kg/m2.
* TG of \>1.7 mmol/L.
* Willing to refrain from consumption of other probiotic products, oat products, barley products and psyllium husk products during the intervention period.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Use of probiotics or prebiotics within 6 weeks before inclusion.
* Systemic antibiotics within 6 weeks before inclusion.
* Daily alcohol consumption \>30 mL.
* Smoker.
* Diagnosed with immunodeficiency.
* Diagnosed with type I and II diabetes mellitus.
* Diagnosed with chronic kidney disease (Stage 3, 4, 5; Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate of 60 ml/min/1.73 m² that has been present for more than three months) (Whelton et al., 2018)
* Diagnosed with cancer or any life-threatening illnesses.
* Diagnosed with decompensated chronic liver disease (e.g., ascites, jaundice, hepatic encephalopathy, or variceal bleeding) (EASL 2018), acute liver failure, acute hepatitis requiring hospitalisation.
* Diagnosed with clinically significant gastrointestinal disease that may affect nutrient absorption, gut microbiota, or study participation (e.g., inflammatory bowel disease, celiac disease, chronic pancreatitis, short bowel syndrome, gastrointestinal obstruction, or active gastrointestinal infection)
* Diagnosed with any acute medical condition requiring hospitalisation
* Diagnosed with organic heart diseases, including but not limited to congenital heart disease, rheumatic heart disease, hypertrophic or dilated cardiomyopathy.
* Breast-feeding or pregnant or plan to become pregnant in the next 6-12 months.
* Participation in another clinical trial within the last 6 months.
* Cognitive impairment and psychological disorders causing incapacity to give informed consent.
* Vulnerable group \[e.g. children (\<18 years old), individuals with physical and cognitive disabilities\]
* Current use of lipid-lowering therapy other than atorvastatin 10-20 mg or simvastatin 20-40 mg or rosuvastatin 5-10 mg, including other statins (pravastatin, lovastatin, fluvastatin, or pitavastatin), ezetimibe, PCSK9 inhibitors, fibrates, omega-3 fatty acid preparations, nicotinic acid (niacin), or any other lipid-lowering medication or supplement.
* Known hypersensitivity or allergy to probiotics, β-glucan, oats or any component of the investigational or placebo products.
